warrior.name: Warrior
warrior.description: A mighty warrior skilled in combat with sword and shield

mage.name: Mage
mage.description: A powerful spellcaster who commands the forces of magic

rogue.name: Rogue
rogue.description: A cunning thief skilled in stealth and precision strikes

goblin.name: Goblin
goblin.description: A small, green-skinned creature with sharp teeth and beady eyes
goblin.encounter_text: A goblin leaps out from behind a rock, brandishing a crude weapon!

wolf.name: Dire Wolf
wolf.description: A massive wolf with razor-sharp fangs and glowing eyes
wolf.encounter_text: A dire wolf emerges from the shadows, its growl sending shivers down your spine!

skeleton.name: Skeleton Warrior
skeleton.description: An undead warrior whose bones rattle as it moves
skeleton.encounter_text: The bones of a fallen warrior rise up, sword in hand, ready for battle!

dragon.name: Ancient Red Dragon
dragon.description: A colossal dragon with scales like molten lava and eyes of burning fire
dragon.encounter_text: The ground trembles as an ancient dragon spreads its massive wings, filling the air with heat!

orc.name: Orc Raider
orc.description: A brutish orc warrior covered in battle scars
orc.encounter_text: An orc raider charges toward you, swinging a massive battle axe!

health potion.name: Health Potion
health potion.description: A crimson liquid that restores 30 HP when consumed

mana potion.name: Mana Potion
mana potion.description: A glowing blue liquid that restores magical energy

iron sword.name: Iron Sword
iron sword.description: A sturdy iron blade that adds +10 to attack damage

wooden staff.name: Wooden Staff
wooden staff.description: A gnarled staff that channels magical energy for +12 magic damage

dual daggers.name: Dual Daggers
dual daggers.description: Twin daggers perfect for quick strikes, +8 attack damage each

dragon scale armor.name: Dragon Scale Armor
dragon scale armor.description: Legendary armor crafted from dragon scales, +20 defense

fireball scroll.name: Fireball Scroll
fireball scroll.description: A magical scroll that unleashes a devastating fireball for 50 damage

smoke bomb.name: Smoke Bomb
smoke bomb.description: Creates a cloud of smoke, guaranteeing escape from combat

legendary flame sword.name: Legendary Flame Sword
legendary flame sword.description: A sword wreathed in eternal flames, +30 attack damage

village_square.name: Peaceful Village Square
village_square.description: A quiet village with thatched-roof cottages and friendly townsfolk. The smell of fresh bread wafts from the bakery.

dark_forest.name: Dark Forest
dark_forest.description: Ancient trees block out the sun, their twisted branches creating eerie shadows. You hear strange noises in the distance.

mountain_path.name: Mountain Path
mountain_path.description: A steep, rocky path winds up the mountainside. The air grows thinner and colder with each step.

old_cave.name: Old Cave
old_cave.description: Darkness envelops you as you enter the cave. Water drips from stalactites, echoing through the chambers.

dragons_lair.name: Dragon's Lair
dragons_lair.description: The entrance to a massive cavern. Scorched earth and bones litter the ground. Heat radiates from within.

haunted_ruins.name: Haunted Ruins
haunted_ruins.description: Crumbling stone structures covered in vines. Ghostly whispers seem to emanate from the walls.

quests.title: Rescue the Princess
quests.description: The king's daughter has been kidnapped by the ancient dragon. Brave the Dragon's Lair and bring her home safely.

quests.title: Clear the Goblin Camp
quests.description: A band of goblins has been terrorizing travelers in the Dark Forest. Defeat them and bring peace to the road.

quests.title: Retrieve the Ancient Artifact
quests.description: An ancient magical artifact lies hidden in the Haunted Ruins. Recover it for the village mage.

quests.title: Slay the Mountain Orc Chief
quests.description: A powerful orc chief has claimed the mountain path as his territory. Defeat him to reopen the trade route.

random_events.description: You discover a weathered chest hidden beneath some rubble.
A traveling merchant approaches you, his cart filled with various goods.
random_events.dialogue: Greetings, traveler! Care to see my wares? I have potions and supplies.

random_events.description: An elderly villager rushes toward you, worry etched on their face.
random_events.dialogue: Please, brave adventurer! I need your help with a matter of great urgency.

random_events.description: A fellow adventurer rests by the roadside, tending to their wounds.
random_events.dialogue: Be careful out there. The path ahead is more dangerous than it looks.

random_events.description: You notice a crack in the wall that seems to lead somewhere.
random_events.result: You discover a secret chamber filled with ancient treasures!
Arrows shoot out from the walls!
